name: Hastrekha
tagline: Offline Vedic palm reading from a photo, in English or Hindi.
description: Take a photo of your palm and get a Vedic palm reading in English or Hindi. Hastrekha finds the lines on your phone, lets you check them, then explains the hand type, lines, mounds and signs, life areas, a timeline, your birth star and remedies. Nothing leaves your phone. For reflection and enjoyment, not advice.
